name: Locust-Shade Regalia (Hòe Âm Trang)

bonuses.rule: For every 10 s you hold Composed and do not stop being Composed, gain +5% ward potency (up to +15%) and your next art cannot be evaded. Drops 1 stack per pulse if you stop being Composed.

story: Carried by the Tiêu elders who remember the boatman's silence under the courtyard locust.

name: Twin Bridges Watch (Song Kiều Giáp)

bonuses.rule: While above 50% HP, gain delay and push immunity. Every fifth block burns 3% of the foe's max linh lực into your pool.

story: Worn together only when the bridge watch closes the span.

name: Swallow's Dispatch (Quy Yến Trang)

bonuses.effect: The Swallow Returns to Its Nest
bonuses.rule: Every third Wood art fired grants a follow-up soul hit (c = 1.4).

story: Tạ Hall's dispatch kit — fan, ink-jade, and dispatch seal.

name: Granary Store (Tàng Lương Trang)

bonuses.rule: Starting at 10 s, each 10 s stores one Seed stack (up to 4). When you drop below 20% HP, consume all Seed stacks to heal 8% max HP per stack.

story: Bell, steward seal, and winter seed-gourd kept together by the granary elders.

name: White-Sand Fleet (Bạch Sa Chu Trang)

bonuses.rule: Once per fight, dropping below 50% HP reduces incoming damage by 99% for 2 s, restores 10% max linh lực, and makes your next art certain.

story: Mirror, captain's ring, and salt-proof robe of the Hỗ river pilots.

name: Silk-Reeler's Kit (Sào Ti Trang)

bonuses.rule: When a foe carries 6 or more of your Fire debuff stacks, casting a needle art consumes all Fire debuff stacks to deal immediate fire damage (c = 0.114 per stack).

story: Gold filament needle and worn brass thimble of the Đới elders.
